metadata.name: Baidu Translate
metadata.author: kanaru313
metadata.description: Translates lyrics line by line with Baidu Translate Open API (https://fanyi-api.baidu.com). Needs your own Baidu Translation App ID and Secret Key.

appId.title: Baidu App ID
appId.subtitle: Your Baidu Translation Open API App ID from https://fanyi-api.baidu.com

appSecret.title: Baidu App Secret Key
appSecret.subtitle: Your Baidu Translation Open API Secret Key, stored in system Keyring

keepSymbols.title: Preserve empty and symbol lines
keepSymbols.subtitle: Lines without words (♪, ..., x2) are kept as-is and not sent to Baidu Translate
